verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both estimates are stated, as two declarations about the pair 𝒯_0 = profileStress. Upper bound: profileStress_jets bounds ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (profileStress) (η,x)‖ — all mixed derivatives in (η,δ) of total order i — by A · edge 4 x / x^N on 0 < x ≤ b for any b > 0, with one A and one N serving every i ≤ n, which is at least as strong as the paper's per-I constants C_I, N_I. Lower bound: profileStress_lower_bound gives c · edge 4 x / x^3 ≤ ‖profileStress (η,x)‖ on a collar 0 < x < ε, uniformly for η ∈ Icc (-1) 1, i.e. the paper's |𝒯_0| ≥ c e^{-4/δ²}δ^{-3} for δ small. Two encoding points: edge 4 x = exp(-4/x²) for x > 0, and the norm on ℝ × ℝ is Mathlib's sup norm rather than the Euclidean one (the two differ by a factor in [1, √2], absorbed into A and c). On q-independence: neither statement mentions a physical scale — profileStress takes only (C, d, y0, y), TailData is OutgoingSchedule.Parameters (P, m, lam, wait) plus h, and the scale q enters elsewhere only through chartQ on an EdgeParam, which does not occur here.
